HtmlDescription:
ESJOT aluminium sprockets have been specially developed for the tough conditions of motocross, enduro and road use. Compared to conventional steel sprockets, an ESJOT aluminium sprocket brings a weight saving of over 60%. The use of high-quality aluminium (7075 T6), which is also used in aviation, as well as the extremely low manufacturing tolerances ensure an exceptionally long service life.

  • Over 60% lighter than a conventional steel sprocket
  • Manufactured on precision CNC machines
  • Flatness and concentricity tolerances of less than 0.1mm
  • Made of high quality and high strength aluminium
  • Special surface treatment
  • 100% Made in Germany
  • OEM quality
  • Available in silver, black (BP) and orange (AO) anodised finishes
